usage.callShape: Three x402 ops on api.purch.xyz, all paid in USDC on SOLANA (no API key): GET /x402/search?q=… ($0.01) · POST /x402/shop {message} ($0.10) · POST /x402/buy {asin,email,shippingAddress} (dynamic). Search+Shop pay-tested live 2026-08-07 (200 OK); Buy verified payable via live 402 but NOT purchased (US-shipping-only).

shop.message: comfortable running shoes for marathon training under $150

usage.outputShape: search/shop → {products:[{asin,title,price,currency,rating,reviewCount,imageUrl,productUrl,source,vendor}], totalResults, page, hasMore}; shop also returns a natural-language `reply`. buy → order confirmation (not captured — not purchased).
quirks: PAYMENT IS ON SOLANA, not Base — accepts network solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp, USDC asset EPjFWdd5…, payTo 8LiXrHC6…, gasless via extra.feePayer GVJJ7rdG…. A Base-only wallet CANNOT pay these.
No API key required — pure x402 (the pre-2026-08 apiKey+paid requirement is GONE). Search+Shop pay-tested live 2026-08-07: 200 OK; $0.01 and $0.10 charged on Solana.

BUY IS US-SHIPPING ONLY: a non-US shippingAddress returns HTTP 400 ('Amazon and Shopify orders only support addresses in the US', Crossmint-backed) BEFORE any 402/charge. Do not attempt non-US delivery.

BUY PRICING (reverse-engineered from unpaid live-402 quotes 2026-08-07): quote ≈ live Amazon price + ~12% (tax + Crossmint fee) + shipping. Clean high-value data: $9.99→$11.16 and $42.99→$48.31 (both ~+12%, ~$0 shipping, Prime-eligible). Cheap items carry a near-FLAT ~$4.7–4.9 shipping/handling floor that dominates: $1.07→$5.83, $1.97→$6.87, $1.99→$6.89. A tiny item's huge %-overhead is SHIPPING, not a markup — the real fee markup is ~12%.

SEARCH/SHOP PRICE IS A STALE SNAPSHOT: the buy 402 reflects LIVE Amazon pricing and can be LOWER than the listed price — e.g. listed $7.34 (B00NH11KIK) quoted $5.90 (−20%). Re-quote via Buy before trusting a search price.
Buy is dynamic + irreversible → operation needsApproval=true; the WEB harness must pause for human approval before paying.
Vault endpoints (/x402/vault/search|buy|download) are DOCUMENTED but return 404 — not deployed as of 2026-08-07; omitted from this entry.

HISTORY: hidden 'broken' 2026-06-08 (old routes: POST /x402/buy with no challenge + GET /api/agent/shop → plain-text 404, authMode apiKey+paid). Provider re-architected the x402 surface; revived + re-verified 2026-08-07 at owner's direction.
usage.guide: Purch = agent-native commerce over x402 (Amazon + Shopify), paid in USDC on SOLANA, no API key. Flow: (1) discover — GET /x402/search?q=… ($0.01) or POST /x402/shop {message} ($0.10); both return product cards and Amazon cards carry an `asin`. (2) checkout — POST /x402/buy {asin, email, shippingAddress}; the 402 amount is dynamic (live product price + ~12% tax/fee + shipping) and the order is IRREVERSIBLE, so gate it behind human approval. KNOW: Buy ships to US addresses ONLY (non-US → HTTP 400, no charge); the search/shop price is a snapshot and the real buy price is re-quoted live (can be higher OR lower); cheap items are dominated by a ~$4.7 flat shipping floor while the real fee markup is only ~12%. Pay-tested live 2026-08-07: search+shop 200 OK ($0.01/$0.10 on Solana); buy confirmed payable via live 402 but not purchased.

Optional: limit (1-30, default 20), image_url/base64_image for visual search, filters{...}, config{language,country,currency,keyword_search_only}, page_token (use next_page_token to paginate), include_raw:true to also get Channel3's full upstream response under {data,raw}.

Visual search: pass exactly one of image_url (URI) or base64_image (there is also a dedicated /api/channel3/image-search route).
Flat $0.01 USDC on Base (eip155:8453 USDC); registry may advertise price as 'Varies' — it is fixed.

Trimmed cards by default; pass include_raw:true to also receive Channel3's full upstream payload as {data,raw}. offer fields are limited to url, domain, price, availability, max_commission_rate.
Pagination via next_page_token -> page_token. limit max is 30.
filters use category/brand/website IDs (use the brands/categories/websites lookup routes to resolve slugs->IDs); do not pass display paths.
Two registered backends are the same op via current vs legacy path; v0 additionally accepts an optional `customer` object.

name: StableMerch Custom Merch
description: Create custom shirts/mugs from an image and ship them via Printify. Preview→prepare→commit flow: free SIWX draft + preview, then the single paid x402 commit produces a real shipped order (irreversible).

usage.callShape: GET /api/catalog (free) → POST /api/drafts (SIWX) → preview → prepare-order (SIWX) → commit (x402, ships goods)
usage.outputShape: JSON body (see provider doc).
quirks: GET /api/catalog and POST /api/drafts are FREE (SIWX); show preview_urls before anything else.
commit is the ONLY paid step and it SHIPS A PHYSICAL PRODUCT — irreversible. Requires explicit user OK + shipping address.
Never collect shipping/contact or call commit before the user approves the preview.

APPROVAL-GATED: this is an OUTWARD/irreversible action (real charge / order / shipment). Shape is from the provider OpenAPI/discovery and was NOT QA-executed (we do not place real bookings/purchases as tests). The needsApproval gate fires before any real execution.
usage.guide: StableMerch. 1) GET /api/catalog (free). 2) POST /api/drafts (SIWX) {client_request_id, product_slug, image_url, options} → preview_urls (render them). 3) POST /api/drafts/{id}/prepare-order (SIWX) {address_to} → order_ready. 4) POST /api/drafts/{id}/commit (x402) → ships. Only commit costs money and it's irreversible — defer to explicit user approval.

name: Greeneris ISBN Lookup
description: Resolves an ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 to a normalized bibliographic record from Open Library (Internet Archive): title, subtitle, authors, publishers, publish date, page count, both ISBN identifiers, subjects and cover image URL — for catalog management, e-commerce listings and used-book pricing agents.

isbn.description: ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 (query param, required); hyphens/spaces are tolerated, e.g. 9780140328721

usage.callShape: GET https://data.greeneris.io/v1/books/isbn?isbn=<ISBN-10 or ISBN-13>. Single required query param 'isbn' (e.g. ?isbn=9780140328721); hyphens/spaces are tolerated. No JSON body. Pure x402 (Base USDC, eip155:8453), no API key — the payment is the auth. Result is inline in the 200 body (synchronous), no polling.
usage.outputShape: { ok: boolean, data: { isbn, title, subtitle (nullable), authors: [string], publishers: [string], publish_date, number_of_pages, isbn_10, isbn_13, openlibrary_id, subjects: [string], cover_url, openlibrary_url, source } } — e.g. { ok: true, data: { isbn: '9780140328721', title: 'Fantastic Mr. Fox', subtitle: null, authors: ['Roald Dahl'], publishers: ['Puffin'], publish_date: 'October 1, 1988', number_of_pages: 96, isbn_10: '0140328726', isbn_13: '9780140328721', openlibrary_id: 'OL7353617M', subjects: ['Animals','Hunger','Juvenile fiction','Foxes','Fiction', ...], cover_url: 'https://covers.openlibrary.org/b/id/15152634-L.jpg', openlibrary_url: 'http://openlibrary.org/books/OL7353617M/Fantastic_Mr._Fox', source: 'Open Library (openlibrary.org, Internet Archive)' } }
quirks: 'isbn' is the only param and is REQUIRED; accepts both ISBN-10 and ISBN-13, with hyphens/spaces tolerated (server normalizes).
Unknown/unresolvable ISBNs return HTTP 400 and are NOT charged (per the provider description) — only successful resolutions cost the $0.002.

Data is proxied live from Open Library (openlibrary.org, Internet Archive) with a 7-day cache; coverage/field completeness depends on that upstream (subtitle can be null; subjects list length varies).
Response payload is wrapped in { ok, data } — the book fields live under data.
method enum per the openapi schema also lists HEAD/DELETE, but GET is the read call.
Sibling data.greeneris.io ops are separate services, not variants (e.g. /v1/logistics/gtin-check is a GTIN barcode validator, not this ISBN lookup).
usage.guide: ISBN-to-book resolver, proxied live from Open Library (Internet Archive). GET https://data.greeneris.io/v1/books/isbn?isbn=<ISBN-10 or ISBN-13> — 'isbn' required, hyphens/spaces tolerated. No body, no API key; pay $0.002 USDC on Base via x402, result inline in the 200. Use it to turn a bare ISBN into a listing-ready product record (title, authors, publishers, publish_date, number_of_pages, subjects, cover_url) for catalog management, marketplace listings or used-book pricing. Unknown ISBNs return a free 400, so a 400 means 'not found', not a billing event.
